intent.goal: Close three Greptile threads on rollup PR #387: every .py ban reads all first-party code (app/, lib/, any package dir) while installed dependency code stays out, and no eval can be passed by deleting the files its globs read.
intent.ruled_out: More whack-a-mole (adding app/ and lib/ triples per ban leaves the next unlisted dir blind); detecting venvs by a pyvenv.cfg marker (site-packages and node_modules trees carry none, and it adds I/O per match); failing closed for exists globs (an empty match set is exactly what exists: false asserts, e.g. attest-it's no-fabricated-record check); broadening the document-it/map-it/migrate-it globs (their directories are the case's subject, and workspace-wide they would read the agent's own notes); a validation error for a glob that names a dependency dir (no case does; out of scope).
intent.why: Exclusion is a property of the workspace, not of each ban: one denylist in _glob_files keeps every glob, present and future, off installed code, so each ban can state its real scope (**/*.py) once. Fail-closed makes a regex glob mean 'there is first-party code here and none of it violates', which every ban intends; a path check already failed on a missing file, and exists keeps its meaning.
